sources.title: Generate GPT-2 Poetry with aitextgen - Colab
sources.snippet: AI Poetry Generation with GPT-2 and aitextgen This notebook uses aitextgen and a finetuned AI model (GPT-2 medium: 355M) to generate poetry. The model has been finetuned on corpuses of traditional poetry (gleaned from PoetryDB) and also more contemporary poetry (taken from here), which means that it is optimised for poetry generation.
